newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London steady, activity modest.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London steady, activity modest.

text.p: Japanese shares were little changed in London on Thursday with activity largely confined to the banking sector, traders said.

"We've seen bits and pieces this morning," said one. "There have been a few buyers of bank stocks around but Sanwa Bank is a little bit weaker after a strong run after being included in the Tokyo index."

Shares in Nomura Securities were down in London after it said -- after the Tokyo market's close -- that it would provide financial support totalling 371 billion yen to its non-bank affiliate Nomura Finance Co.
Blue chip stocks were holding steady and activity expected to stay quiet ahead of Monday's national holiday.
The Nikkei 50 in London was trading just 0.07 points lower at 1,437.12 at 1317 GMT.
"The underlying tone still seems to be quite firm," said one trader.
Overnight in Tokyo, technical buying linked with futures trading drove the Nikkei 225 166.10 points lower to 21,322.85.
